events.name: The Toll Bridge
events.text: A troll sits at the end of a rickety bridge, tapping a heavy club. "Pay up, or prove you're worth letting by."

events.name: The Tinker's Bench
events.text: A traveling tinker has set up a workbench by the road, tools laid out and a kettle on the boil. "Something need fixing?"

events.name: The Wishing Well
events.text: An old well hums faintly in the middle of a clearing. Drop something in, and it hums back.

events.name: The Sleeping Giant
events.text: A giant snores across the path, a heap of gold spilling from his pockets. Every grab is a gamble.

events.name: The Spark Shrine
events.text: Three stone bowls glow at a mossy shrine, one each for Ember, Tide and Gale. The party may kneel at one.

events.name: The Lost Courier
events.text: A courier sits on a milestone, sweating, with one parcel left and no idea where it goes. "Take it off my hands, or take my fee."

events.name: The Mirror Pond
events.text: The pond is perfectly still. Lean over it and your reflection reaches back, holding something familiar.

events.name: The Twin Forge
events.text: Two anvils face each other in a ruined smithy, a single fire burning between them. Something could be joined here.
